translations.web: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
translations.bsb: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
translations.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
translations.asv: Wherein God, being minded to show more abundantly unto the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;
